def find_symmetric_difference(list1, list2):
    """
    show difference
    :param list1:
    :type list1:
    :param list2:
    :type list2:
    :return:
    :rtype:
    """

    difference = set(list1).symmetric_difference(set(list2))
    list_difference = list(difference)

    return list_difference
